description:
Sidney Crosby, already boasting an incredible list of accomplishments in his storied career, hit another milestone by scoring his 600th career goal. On the power play, Crosby found space near the side of the net, took a perfect feed from Erik Karlsson, and buried the puck to etch his name further into hockey history. The Pittsburgh bench emptied as teammates swarmed their captain on the ice, sharing the moment with an ecstatic home crowd. With this goal, Crosby becomes just the 21st player in NHL history to reach the 600-goal milestone.

description:
Andrei Vasilevskiy made history at home against a tough opponent, becoming the fastest goaltender ever to reach 300 career wins and the only one to achieve the milestone in fewer than 500 games. He hit the mark in his 490th career appearance, surpassing Jacques Plante's record of 521 games. Vasilevskiy was stellar in the crease, stopping 23 of 24 shots and earning first-star honors for his performance. Already a two-time Stanley Cup champion, Vezina Trophy winner, and Conn Smythe Trophy recipient, Vasilevskiy continues to build an extraordinary legacy.

description:
In his 19th NHL season, all spent with the Pittsburgh Penguins, Evgeni Malkin reached a historic milestone by scoring his 500th career goal. With a Penguins power play just expired, Malkin broke toward the net and received a crisp pass from Sidney Crosby, stationed below the goal line. Although his initial attempt was stopped, Malkin's determination paid off as he slammed the rebound home while sprawled on the ice. Finishing the game with one goal and three assists, Malkin delivered a memorable performance in front of an electrified home crowd. At the time of the milestone, he ranked third in both goals and points in the storied history of the Penguins franchise.

description:
Sergei Bobrovsky made NHL history as the fastest goaltender to reach 400 career wins, becoming just the 14th netminder to achieve this milestone. Bobrovsky accomplished the feat in only 707 games, surpassing the previous record held by Henrik Lundqvist by 20 games.  
In his milestone victory against the New York Rangers, Bobrovsky delivered a standout performance with several clutch saves. During a Rangers power play in the first period, he denied Chris Kreider twice from point-blank range at the doorstep. In the second period, Bobrovsky silenced the New York crowd once again with a stunning sequence: he stopped a dangerous wrist shot from Braden Schneider in the slot and immediately followed it up with a right-pad save on Vincent Trocheck’s close-range rebound attempt.  
Already a Stanley Cup champion and two-time Vezina Trophy winner, Bobrovsky continues to add remarkable achievements to his illustrious career.

description:
After narrowly missing the 100-point milestone in previous seasons, Mitch Marner finally achieves the feat in his ninth NHL campaign. Late in the third period, Auston Matthews delivers a slick spin-around pass across the net, setting up Marner to bury the puck and secure his landmark moment. Marner capped off the season with a career-best 75 assists and 27 goals, finishing with an impressive 102 points.

description:
With just nine seconds left on the clock, Filip Gustavsson etched his name in NHL history, becoming the 15th goaltender ever credited with a goal. After gloving down a neutral-zone slap shot from the Blues, the Wild netminder wasted no time. He dropped the puck to his stick, dropped to one knee, and launched a high, arcing shot the length of the ice. It landed perfectly in the offensive zone and rolled into the empty net, sealing a 4-1 victory. His teammates on the ice immediately swarmed Gustavsson to celebrate the unforgettable moment.

description:
Nathan MacKinnon made history at home against the Chicago Blackhawks, becoming the 100th player to join the prestigious 1,000-point club. Reaching the milestone in just his 856th career game, he became the fourth-fastest among all active players to achieve the feat. Battling for the puck in the corner, MacKinnon emerged with possession, skated around the net, and fed it to Devon Toews at the point. Toews’ shot was tipped in by Artturi Lehkonen, earning MacKinnon his milestone point. He later added another assist, finishing with two points in the Avalanche’s victory.
